dial.summary: DXY firmed to ~102.43 on FOMC decision day while real yields hold near 2.64% (Oct 22 FRED; FRED API blocked Oct 24–28) — both above-threshold headwinds persist; Global M2 continues its uptrend at $103.7T (Aug G4 aggregate; US M2 updated Sep at $23.4T per Oct 27 H.6 release) and the Fed balance sheet remains stable at $6.75T; BTC.D climbed to ~60.1% (Oct 23) with funding at 0.0087% signalling spot-led accumulation; 2s10s flattened to +0.26% but curve remains positive; BTC Accumulation maintained through FOMC hold consensus and Oct 29 GDP/PCE catalyst cluster.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.7T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM per MacroMicro); US M2 H.6 released October 27, 2026: September 2026 US M2 = $23,413.9B (+5.7% YoY), continued expansion; full G4 September aggregate unavailable (6–8 week reporting lag); 4-week trend UP (August above July; US M2 Sep > Aug confirms the uptrend); status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August was 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); S&P Global flash US Manufacturing PMI for October came in at 56.0 (vs 55.9 in September, a separate index); October 2026 ISM PMI due November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET (Polymarket consensus ~52.0–52.9 range); status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~102.43 on October 28, 2026 (Trading Economics session value 102.4103, up ~0.02% from prior close; FXStreet Oct 28: 'United States Dollar Index strengthens to near 102.50, Fed rate decision looms'); 4-week trend UP from ~100.5 on Sep 26 to ~102.43 (+1.9%); DXY recovery from Oct 14 intraday high of ~102.94 stalled and is rebounding ahead of FOMC decision at 2:00 PM ET; status headwind (above 100 threshold); market pricing ~94% probability of a hold at 3.75%–4.00%.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.64% on Oct 22, 2026 (FRED H.15 confirmed in prior run; sequence: Oct 14=2.84%, Oct 19=2.80%, Oct 20=2.77%, Oct 21=2.76%, Oct 22=2.64%); FRED API blocked this run (proxy rejection) — Oct 24–28 FRED values unavailable; web sources (Riskcurve, TreasuryRateWatch) confirm Oct 21=2.76% consistent with prior sequence; estimated Oct 27–28 real yield ~2.62–2.65% (10Y nominal ~4.995% minus breakeven ~2.37%); 4-week trend FLAT vs ~Sep 26 (~2.60–2.65%) within flat threshold; status headwind (above 2%); value held at Oct 22 confirmed FRED reading.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 27, 2026 close: 10Y at ~4.995%, 2Y at ~4.737%, spread ~+0.26% (+26bp); two independent sources agree: Cappnotes (2Y 4.737%/10Y 4.995% = 25.8bp) and Au79 Macro Research (2Y 4.72%/10Y 4.98% = +26bp flattening from prior +30bp); 4-week trend DOWN from ~+0.42% on Sep 19–24 to +0.26% (−16bp as 2Y yields rose into FOMC); curve remains positively sloped but near cycle low; status neutral (positive but flattening); FOMC decision today (Oct 28 2:00 PM ET) is next curve catalyst.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,753,604M ($6.754T) for week ending October 21, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 22; Oct 14 = $6,755,639M, Oct 7 = $6,747,560M, Sep 30 = $6,743,031M); 4-week trend flat: Sep 30 $6,743T → Oct 21 $6,754T = +$11B (+0.16%); FRED API blocked this run — values confirmed via Fed H.4.1 page and secondary trackers (Bizstats Dashboard, Bipartisan Policy Center); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau); next H.4.1 due October 29, 2026 (week ended Oct 28 — first read including today's FOMC day settlement).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC open-interest-weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0087% (Defirate OI-weighted average across 7+ exchanges, Oct 22, 2026; ~9.6% annualized); Oct 27 macro commentary (Au79) describes funding as 'stable at about 0.005% per 8h' — likely a rounded approximation; Coinglass blocked this run; 30-day trend UP from ~0.0067% on Sep 23 to ~0.0087%; well below the 0.04% per 8h overheating threshold; BTC.D climbed to ~60.1% (CoinStats Oct 23) vs prior 59.5%, confirming BTC-led positioning; status supportive (low-leverage, spot-led accumulation posture).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$299.1B (DefiLlama Oct 28, 2026; CoinGecko shows ~$303B at 10.98%) vs total crypto ~$2.72T (CoinStats Oct 23: BTC ~$1.63T at $81,600, BTC.D ~60.1%); dominance ~11.0% ($299B / $2.72T); BTC.D at ~60.1% (CoinStats Oct 23, up from 59.5%; MEXC/CapMad confirm BTC.D climbed back above 60% in October 2026); 30-day trend UP (Sep 23 ~10.5% → Oct 28 ~11.0%); status neutral — headwind condition (rising dominance + rising TOTAL) NOT triggered because TOTAL is declining from $2.79T to ~$2.72T while stablecoin supply flat; rising dominance reflects shrinking denominator, not fear inflows; Coingecko direct fetch blocked.

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 Advance Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP advance estimate at 8:30 AM ET — first read on Q3 output; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and elevated Prices Paid suggest continued expansion; September Retail Sales beat (+0.8% MoM vs +0.3% expected, released Oct 15) adds further evidence of Q3 resilience; released same day as PCE and one day after FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: PCE Deflator (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases September 2026 Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — the Fed's preferred inflation gauge; released the day after the FOMC decision; a hot PCE following hot CPI (3.7% YoY) and PPI (6.3% YoY) would validate any Oct 28 hike and sustain DXY and real yield headwinds into Q4 2026; September Retail Sales beat (+0.8% MoM) supports continued demand-driven price pressure.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 25, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 25, 2026 — first post-FOMC labor read; released same day as GDP advance estimate and PCE; any sharp spike above 230K would immediately test the Oct 28 hike narrative and weigh on risk assets.

upcoming.title: ECB Rate Decision (October 2026)
upcoming.note: European Central Bank Governing Council rate decision on October 29, 2026 at 14:15 CET (no new staff projections at this meeting); current ECB deposit rate at 2.50% (raised Sep 16, 2026); market pricing implied ~60% probability of a 25bp hike to 2.75%; a hawkish hike could strengthen EUR and ease DXY headwinds for risk assets; released same day as US GDP and PCE advance estimates.

upcoming.title: BOJ Rate Decision & Quarterly Outlook Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting concludes October 30, 2026 (two-day meeting begins Oct 29); Quarterly Outlook Report published alongside decision — one of the most data-rich BOJ meetings of the year; current policy rate 1.25% (raised 25bps on Sep 24, 2026, 7-2 vote); BOJ rate path affects JPY strength and by extension global dollar liquidity; a further hike or hawkish guidance would strengthen JPY and pressure global M2 dollar-denominated aggregates.

upcoming.title: Employment Cost Index Q3 2026
upcoming.note: BLS releases the Employment Cost Index for Q3 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — same day as BOJ decision; the ECI is a broad measure of wage and salary growth the Fed monitors alongside PCE; Q2 2026 ECI came in at +0.9% QoQ; a reading above 1.0% would reinforce the Fed's inflation concerns and validate continued hiking; a surprise miss would be the first sign of labor-cost deceleration.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first read on Q4 manufacturing activity; September was 54.5% with Prices Paid at 77.9% (multi-year high); first post-FOMC PMI print and a key data point for the December 8–9 FOMC meeting; a print below 52 following the October 22 yield rally would suggest deceleration and reinforce a December hold.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases September 2026 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) at 10:00 AM ET — provides a fuller picture of the labor market to pair with the September NFP of +29K (the weakest print of the cycle); a sharp drop in job openings below 7M would add evidence of labor market softening and complicate the narrative for further Fed hikes.

upcoming.title: ADP Employment Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases the October 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET — private-sector payroll preview ahead of the official BLS Employment Situation (NFP) on November 6; September NFP came in at +29K (weakest of the cycle); a sharp ADP beat would raise expectations for October NFP and reinforce the case for a December 8–9 FOMC hike; a miss would compound recession concerns.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first post-FOMC services activity read; a combined strong Services PMI + ADP beat would solidify December 8–9 hiking expectations and sustain DXY and real yield headwinds for risk assets into Q4.
